en.text: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

zhSimplified.text: 约拿在鱼腹中祷告耶和华—他的 神，

zhTraditional.text: 約拿在魚腹中禱告耶和華－他的上帝，

en.text: He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.

footnotes.text: 2:2 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 说： 我遭遇患难求告耶和华， 你就应允我； 从阴间的深处呼求， 你就俯听我的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 說： 我遭遇患難求告耶和華， 你就應允我； 從陰間的深處呼求， 你就俯聽我的聲音。

en.text: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.

zhSimplified.text: 你将我投下深渊， 就是海的深处； 大水环绕我， 你的波浪洪涛都漫过我身。

zhTraditional.text: 你將我投下深淵， 就是海的深處； 大水環繞我， 你的波浪洪濤都漫過我身。

en.text: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

zhSimplified.text: 我说：我从你眼前虽被驱逐， 我仍要仰望你的圣殿。

zhTraditional.text: 我說：我從你眼前雖被驅逐， 我仍要仰望你的聖殿。

en.text: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.

zhSimplified.text: 诸水环绕我，几乎淹没我； 深渊围住我； 海草缠绕我的头。

zhTraditional.text: 諸水環繞我，幾乎淹沒我； 深淵圍住我； 海草纏繞我的頭。

en.text: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.

zhSimplified.text: 我下到山根， 地的门将我永远关住。 耶和华—我的 神啊， 你却将我的性命从坑中救出来。

zhTraditional.text: 我下到山根， 地的門將我永遠關住。 耶和華－我的上帝啊， 你卻將我的性命從坑中救出來。

en.text: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

zhSimplified.text: 我心在我里面发昏的时候， 我就想念耶和华。 我的祷告进入你的圣殿， 达到你的面前。

zhTraditional.text: 我心在我裏面發昏的時候， 我就想念耶和華。 我的禱告進入你的聖殿， 達到你的面前。

en.text: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

zhSimplified.text: 那信奉虚无之神的人， 离弃怜爱他们的主；

zhTraditional.text: 那信奉虛無之神的人， 離棄憐愛他們的主；

en.text: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.”

zhSimplified.text: 但我必用感谢的声音献祭与你。 我所许的愿，我必偿还。 救恩出于耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 但我必用感謝的聲音獻祭與你。 我所許的願，我必償還。 救恩出於耶和華。

en.text: Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华吩咐鱼，鱼就把约拿吐在旱地上。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華吩咐魚，魚就把約拿吐在旱地上。
